_readme: Order of the catalogue for salespeople. popular: species codes in the order they should appear first (Sort by: Most popular). lesser: species we want to push (lesser known), shown after the popular ones, also in the order given. Everything else follows A-Z. Later this order will be editable from the admin account. hidden: species codes that are not shown in the portals. Used until the Administration > Catalogue screen (table catalogue_settings) has data; then that screen decides.
